summary: Presents NERD, an experimental database for LISP and a discussion of how to deliver endpoint-identifier to routing-locator mappings to routers in a reliable, scalable and secure way. It takes a push approach, with the whole database distributed rather than looked up on demand.

eli5.summary: Instead of phoning for every address you need, you get a copy of the whole phone book delivered and kept up to date.

questions: how can lisp mappings be distributed to routers
